links.comparator_used: Base Llama-3-70B output without the CHECK safety layer
links.outcome: Hallucination rate in physician QA about pivotal oncology trials
links.quote: In a high-stakes setting of physician question and answer (QA) about pivotal oncology trials, where misinformation can have severe consequences, CHECK reduced hallucinations in a state-of-the-art open model (Llama-3-70B) from a clinically untenable 31\% to just 0.3\%.

links.comparator_used: Unrefined GPT-4o answers without hallucination-probability-guided refinement
links.effect: Pass rate improved by five percentage points to 92.1%; compute significantly reduced; detection AUCs 0.95-0.98 across models and tasks
links.quote: As a practical application, we demonstrate that the hallucination probability signal from CHECK can guide an iterative refinement process, improving GPT-4o’s USMLE pass rate by five percentage points to a new state-of-the-art of 92.1\% while significantly reducing compute.

design_hint: model-agnostic hallucination detection safety layer suppressing unsafe outputs
